purpose: One independent reproducibility confirmation, not best-number selection or tuning.

original_measurement.relationship: Original measurement was taken during development before formatting and final host ABI dimension/pointer/mode guards. This run measures the committed d2c3668 source and its rebuilt CUDA library. Hot numerical device algorithms and the 66-case protocol are unchanged; existing paper claims continue to reference the original data. Documentation may be edited concurrently; all runtime sources and the library are checked immutable.

interpretation: No functional or material device-latency regression observed. Parallel-reduction graph case medians stayed within -1.08%/+1.42% of the original. Eager host-wall times were noisier for both methods; all samples and the slower results are retained. Every complete pipeline remains slower than the dense baseline and no finite setup amortization appears. No further sweep or tuning was performed.
